conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5% monthly return, prioritizing capital preservation. Expect significantly reduced volatility and drawdown potential, but also lower growth. The focus is on de-risking the portfolio.

Be aware of substantially higher volatility, larger potential drawdowns, and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is critical to manage amplified risks.
